rationale: Calculate features based on customer purchase history and product characteristics to predict purchases in the next 7 days.

derived.name: f_recent_transactions
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_avg_days_ago < 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_high_frequency_customer
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_total_transactions > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_diversified_purchases
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_unique_products > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

derived.name: f_expensive_customers
derived.sql: CASE WHEN f_avg_price > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
